subject: NexWave capacity sync — proposed sizing agenda & slots
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Khan <samir@nextwave.ai>, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@nextwave.ai>
Cc: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-11T15:04:00Z
Subject: NexWave capacity sync — proposed sizing agenda & slots

Hi Samir / Elena,

Thanks again for the discovery call earlier today — really appreciate the clarity on your latency targets and the bursty inference pattern during business hours. Quick recap and a proposed next step so we can lock in a dedicated sizing session: 

Recap (from today's discovery)
- Workload: real-time document classification + short-form summarization for customer support.
- Expected QPS: average 120 requests/minute during business hours, spiking to ~450 requests/minute during incidents.
- Latency SLO: 95th pct <= 150 ms for single-part prompts; some multi-prompt flows can tolerate 300 ms.
- Peak concurrency estimate: 80 concurrent active sessions (each session issues streaming tokens).
- Data needs: inference in VPC with KMS; logs retained 30 days max.

Proposed goal for sizing call (45–60 min)
1) Validate throughput / concurrency numbers with sample traces + token distributions
2) Walk through model variants (quantized vs fp16), expected token cost tradeoffs
3) Agree target Dedicated pool sizing and autoscale guardrails (burst windows / cold start behavior)
4) Action items & timeline for a pilot (POC/Reserved capacity)

Suggested slots (PT):
- Tue Oct 12 — 10:00–10:45 PT
- Tue Oct 12 — 13:30–14:15 PT
- Wed Oct 13 — 09:00–09:45 PT

If none of those work, feel free to pick a time here: https://calendly.com/mina-redwood/nexwave-sizing-30m

Prep items for your team (if you can share ahead of the call)
- Sample request logs or a 15–30 minute token histogram (CSV) — we've attached a workload template you can drop data into.
- Any strict egress/network constraints (we included a network-diagram.png stub).

Attachments (stubs): redwood-ops-deck.pdf (2-pg ops summary), nexwave-workload-template.csv, network-diagram.png

Happy to keep this high level or bring an infra engineer — I have Dev on cc to join if you want deep kernel/runtime questions covered.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mina@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
